liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **The Greatest Story Ever Told**: rare: 12 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **deadco2024-07-06.21rooms1willdo** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 185 min [1]. Said about its sound: The uploader mixed Women Are Smarter lyrics into the recording [1]
- **deadco2024-07-06**: audience recording; 19 songs; 185 min [2]
- **deadco2024-07-06.spheresect408.aud**: audience recording; 18 songs; 183 min [3]
- **deadco2024-07-06.Roland**: source not stated; 19 songs; 187 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Crowd 1st Set, Crowd 2nd Set [1]
- Lineup listed: Bobby Weir, Mickey Hart, John Mayer and Oteil Burbridge, with their instruments and vocal roles [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2024-07-06.21rooms1willdo**: taped by 21rooms1willdo; transferred by Hunter S; source: Zoom H5 Handheld onboard mics [1]. Also: Recorded with a handheld Zoom H5 using its onboard mics; transfer path went SD to WAV to Reaper to 24-bit FLAC [1]
- **deadco2024-07-06**: taped by Sir Chu Sonoran Dawg; transferred by Sir Chu Sonoran Dawg; source: AUD > Section 208 > iQ7 > iPhone14 [2]
- **deadco2024-07-06.spheresect408.aud**: taped by TheAnalogKid68; transferred by TheAnalogKid68; source: AUD [3]
- **deadco2024-07-06.Roland**: taped by Cliff Morse; transferred by Cliff Morse; source: CA11(cardioid)>CA UGLY-Pre>Roland R07(24bit float,48kHz) [4]
